subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw support non-USD configured model costs, and if so should currency live per model, per provider, globally, or only as a display preference?
rationale: The request adds a high-bar config surface and changes cost semantics across status output, usage aggregation, UI display, persisted USD fields, and provider billing concepts that code cannot safely infer.

options.title: Define full currency contract
options.body: Choose scope, units, aggregation behavior, and storage/display semantics before implementation so cost surfaces remain consistent.

options.title: Keep model costs USD-only
options.body: Leave configured model pricing as USD estimates and rely on provider usage hooks for non-USD account balances until demand or design is stronger.

options.title: Add display-only preference
options.body: Allow a narrow symbol preference while explicitly preserving `estimatedCostUsd` as USD-like estimate data and accepting mixed-currency ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Define full currency contract
recommendation.body: Choose scope, units, aggregation behavior, and storage/display semantics before implementation so cost surfaces remain consistent.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current history across the USD model cost contract, cost summaries, status formatting, and provider usage surfaces.
